cards.title: Play School Returns: Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: Play School offers a refreshing alternative to frantic children's programming designed to grab attention like smartphones do. Parents appreciate having quality content they feel comfortable letting their toddlers watch.

cards.title: Managing Work-Life Balance as a Parent
cards.body: Working parents face endless logistical challenges balancing job demands with school schedules. Better school holiday support could help parents actually enjoy time with their kids instead of juggling work.

cards.title: Estranged Parents: Reconnecting With Adult Children
cards.body: Shame and perfectionism can prevent parents from rebuilding relationships with their estranged adult children. Working through these barriers with courage can support healthy repair and reconnection.

cards.title: New Moms Need Real Social Support
cards.body: New mothers can feel isolated and lonely even when constantly with their babies. Research shows different types of socializing significantly impact mothers' emotional well-being in early parenthood.

cards.title: Grief When Adult Children Leave Home
cards.body: While some parents feel relief, others struggle deeply with grief when children leave home. Understanding common sources of this pain can help parents move forward and adjust.

cards.title: Rise in Babies Entering Care Proceedings
cards.body: Experts warn that more babies are entering care proceedings, potentially leading to unnecessary adoptions. With better family support services, many babies might not need to enter the care system.

cards.title: Starting Retirement Funds for Young Children
cards.body: Growing numbers of parents are opening pension funds for their toddlers and young children. This long-term savings strategy aims to give kids a financial advantage by adulthood.
